purpose: Durable method knowledge discovered during Financial Writing architecture/research work. Cataloging a method does not promote it into a rule; adoption requires fit/misfit analysis, counterexamples, regression/eval evidence and owner-scoped promotion.

records.method: micro -> macro/topology -> assumption challenge -> external research -> counterexample/verification by risk
records.fit: Direct fit for material Financial decisions and problem repair.
records.misfit: Do not turn every harmless mechanical action into a heavyweight debate loop.

records.method: problem -> research/reflection -> failure class -> candidate -> reproducible eval -> owner promotion -> post-promotion observation -> keep/rollback/retire
records.fit: Direct fit for Financial business-rule evolution.
records.misfit: A single user suggestion cannot directly become a permanent universal rule.

records.method: single domain owner may use serial, parallel, competitive, critique/revision and owner-adjudication workstreams without creating a second business controller
records.fit: Supports focused research/writer/critic passes while retaining one Financial owner.
records.misfit: Do not create cosmetic multi-agent role-play when tools, policy and output contracts do not materially differ.
records.revalidation_trigger: workflow topology or host orchestration changes

records.method: use evals and traces to justify architecture complexity; multi-agent adds nondeterminism and should be driven by measured need
records.fit: Supports rejecting premature multi-agent decomposition and requiring observable quality evals.
records.misfit: Not a substitute for domain-specific writing/evidence standards.

records.method: separate generation from evaluation when criteria are articulable; parallelize independent considerations
records.fit: Strong fit for writer -> reader/editor/style/originality/fact critique loops.
records.misfit: Same-context critiques are not independent certification and unbounded loops can create cost/noise.

records.method: protect important architectural characteristics with executable fitness functions rather than inspection-only governance
records.fit: Directly addresses prior soft PASS audit failure by making invariant checks executable.
records.misfit: Semantic prose quality cannot be reduced entirely to deterministic metrics; human/model judgment still needs evidence-backed review.

records.method: preserve decision context, selected option, alternatives and consequences; supersede instead of rewriting decision history
records.fit: Useful for durable Financial architecture decisions and rejected alternatives.
records.misfit: Do not create an ADR for every trivial article edit.

records.method: specific/anecdotal lead -> early context/promise -> evidence/counterevidence progression; preserve enough unresolved payoff to keep reading
records.fit: Strong option for finance explanatory features and company-led openings.
records.misfit: Not every article should use anecdotal lead or a fixed nut-graf template.
records.revalidation_trigger: reader performance contradicts the method for target platform

records.method: lead -> nut/context -> renewed detail/scene -> rounding material -> kicker
records.fit: Useful candidate for long explanatory pieces needing periodic interest renewal.
records.misfit: Must not become a universal five-section shell.

records.method: choose structure after understanding material; form follows content rather than forcing every story into one template
records.fit: Core antidote to template-heavy Financial prose.
records.misfit: Freedom of form does not remove numbering, evidence, or platform obligations.
records.revalidation_trigger: none unless contradicted by product constraints

records.method: make a concrete, salient knowledge gap visible and progressively close it; curiosity is strongest when the gap is meaningful and tractable
records.misfit: Clicks can rise without satisfaction; unresolved or vague clickbait gaps can backfire.

records.method: storytelling structure materially affects engagement; headline strength alone cannot guarantee retention
records.fit: Supports first-class story blueprint and reader-dropoff audit.
records.misfit: One study and one audience cannot define a universal emotional arc for financial writing.
records.revalidation_trigger: stronger cross-domain reading research or platform data

records.method: use original content, language and phrasing; rewrite outside material for the target audience and retain attribution where the source itself is material
records.fit: Direct fit for originality gate and source-to-note-to-prose separation.
records.misfit: Financial publication-source privacy still requires separating research provenance from reader-facing attribution when source identity is not part of the claim.

records.method: close paraphrase/patchwriting remains problematic even when wording is changed locally; understand, set source aside, then express the idea in a new form and compare back
records.fit: Useful operational method for preventing source-shaped prose and suspected plagiarism.
records.misfit: Academic citation conventions are not copied wholesale into public finance articles.
